components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. Submitted numbers may include spaces,
            dashes and brackets and may carry an explicit '+' country code; they are stored
            and returned in E.164 form (a '+' followed by 8 to 15 digits). A number without a
            '+' is assumed to be Australian ('+61'), dropping a single leading '0'.
          type: string
          minLength: 2
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^\+?[0-9 ()\-]{2,20}$'
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          minLength: 3
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the pet owner was registered. When omitted on creation it
            defaults to the server's current date. Formatted as 'YYYY-MM-DD'.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            Create-time flag. When true, the owner is allowed to be created even though another
            owner already has the same last name and address (people who share a household).
            When false or omitted, such a duplicate is rejected with 409 Conflict.
          type: boolean
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone

      title: Owner

              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1

              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.

              example: Franklin, George
              readOnly: true
            initials:

              description: The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName, dot-separated with a trailing dot.

## Summary

I implemented `namesakeCount` on the `POST /api/owners` endpoint: the number of existing owners sharing the same firstName and lastName (case-insensitive), counted before the new owner is persisted, then frozen and returned on reads.

Changes:

1. **`openapi.yml`** — added a `readOnly` integer `namesakeCount` property to the `Owner` schema, so the generated `OwnerDto` carries it.

2. **`Owner.java` model** — added a `namesake_count` column mapped to an `Integer namesakeCount` field with getter/setter. MapStruct maps it to/from `OwnerDto` automatically by name (same as the existing `customerCode`/`householdId`).

4. **New function `CountOwnerNamesakes`** — reads the built `Owner` via `@Val`, counts matching owners from `OwnerRepository.findAll()` comparing first+last name case-insensitively, and sets the count. Because it runs before `SaveOwner`, the new owner isn't counted among its own namesakes.

5. **`owners.POST.yml`** — inserted a `countNamesakes` step (with `govern: [ transaction ]`) between `assignCustomerCode` and `save`.

The acceptance test `coreCountsNamesakes` (two owners sharing first+last name but different postcodes) now returns `namesakeCount = 1` on the second owner's `GET`, as specified.
